name: io.github.omnicoreos/planka-mcp
title: Planka MCP
description: Planka 2.x MCP server with verified card, task, comment, label, and list operations.

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Planka base URL, for example https://planka.example.com

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Planka API key (X-Api-Key). Recommended: replaces the email/password login

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_AGENT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email or username of the Planka agent user. Only needed when PLANKA_API_KEY is not set

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_AGENT_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password of the Planka agent user. Only needed when PLANKA_API_KEY is not set

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_DEFAULT_BOARD_ID
environmentVariables.description: Board id used when a tool call omits boardId

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_ALLOWED_BOARD_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated board ids this server may see and touch. Everything else is hidden

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_ALLOWED_PROJECT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated project ids this server may see. Everything else is hidden

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to hide and refuse every write tool

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_DISABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names to switch off, for example planka_get_board

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_PROTECTED_LIST_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list ids that must not receive cards nor be edited or deleted

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_HIDE_DEPRECATED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to drop the deprecated tool aliases from tools/list. They stay callable

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_SUMMARY_HIGHLIGHT_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: Label planka_board_summary flags as unblocked/ready. Unset: no highlighting

environmentVariables.name: PLANKA_SUMMARY_DECISION_LISTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated columns planka_board_summary returns cards from when the call does not say
